paraphrase.proposes: This chore track updates every package in extensions/measure-status and plugins/opencode-measure-guard to the latest working version. Phase 1 takes the smallest version steps that clear all critical and high advisories by 2026-11-23, with named floors that Green may exceed when the audit data requires it. Phase 2 takes the latest working versions for the rest and writes the reasoned moderate and low list by 2026-11-25. Red writes the audit test and fixtures, Green writes the audit script, and the record file is advisories.md. All work stays on chore/deps-refresh and is pushed only to origin/chore/deps-refresh.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, extensions/measure-status is an OpenChamber 2.7.1 and newer panel extension with five dev dependencies and a committed esbuild bundle at panel/main.js. plugins/opencode-measure-guard is a Bun-loaded OpenCode 2 plugin with pinned dev dependencies and peer floors of @opencode/plugin >=2.0.0, @opentui/* >=0.6.6 and solid-js >=1.9.0. The 2026-11-22 bun audit recorded 21 advisories in measure-status (4 critical, 5 high, 11 moderate, 1 low) and 8 in the guard (1 critical, 4 high, 3 moderate).
